caption_L1: This is a bar graph titled Annual change in number of United States residents traveling to Mexico from 2002 to 2019. The x-axis measures Year on categorical scale starting at 2002 and ending at 2019* while the y-axis shows Year-over-year change on categorical scale from −0.05 to 0.20.
caption_L2L3: Between 2002 and 2009 United States residents left Mexico as well as travelling to Mexico. From 2009 until 2019 United States residents only travelled to Mexico. There was a significant increase in United States residents travelling to Mexico in 2014.
